overview.description: The MFS Blended Research Emerging Markets Equity ETF (BREE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in equities of companies tied economically to emerging market countries. The portfolio blends fundamental and quantitative research to construct a diversified emerging markets equity portfolio. BREE was launched on Mar 5, 2026 and is issued by MFS.
